listing:
2BR apartment, Erb St W — take over my winter term (Jan 1–Apr 30)

I'm heading to Toronto for co-op so I'm looking for one or two students to take over my two-bedroom at 500 block Erb St W (exact: 531 Erb St W, Unit 14). Rent is $1,900/mo total for the unit ($950 each if two of you), heat and water included, hydro about $70 split. Furnished living room, kitchen fully equipped. Close to the Laurel Creek trails and 15 mins to UW on foot. Landlord lives off-site and has consented to the sublet in writing (I'm happy to show you the email). I'd love to host a viewing in person; if you're out of town we can do a video call and I'll go room by room. Rent by bank transfer, due on the 1st. First month is paid when we both sign the sublet agreement, nothing before.
label_rationale: Whole 2-bed at ordinary market rent, address, in-person and video viewing, off-site landlord with written consent (RTA s.97(1)), explicit 'nothing before' signing (the opposite of the CAFC bulletin pattern of sending first and last months' rent before seeing the unit). ADMIT.
